name: Turn meeting notes into a task list
description: Pulls out decisions and next steps, then saves them as checkboxes in a note.
when_to_use: Use it after a meeting when you want action items separated from the discussion.
goal: Turn meeting notes into a clear task list with checkboxes.

acceptance.cmd: find "$GLACIER_HOME/vault/tasks" -type f -name 'meeting-list-*.md' -mmin -10 -print0 | xargs -0 grep -q . && (find "$GLACIER_HOME/vault/tasks" -type f -name 'meeting-list-*.md' -mmin -10 -print0 | xargs -0 grep -q '\[ \]' || find "$GLACIER_HOME/vault/tasks" -type f -name 'meeting-list-*.md' -mmin -10 -print0 | xargs -0 grep -qi 'no tasks')

config.source: Set this to your meeting-notes file, for example $HOME/Documents/meeting-notes.txt
